# UIFormComponent

*Client* · extends [`UIComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIComponent)

Shows a BBS form (a model with its animations) in a script UI.

## Methods

### form {#form}

::: member

Shows a form fitted into the component, as in BBS form pickers.

```js
ui.form().form(scram.form('{"id":"bbs:mob","mobId":"minecraft:pig"}')).wh(100, 150);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `form` | [`BBSForm`](/scripting/common/bbs/BBSForm) | form to show, not null; later changes to it show here too |

**Returns** [`UIFormComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIFormComponent) — this form preview

:::
